questions.q: Where had Paul left Titus?
What was Titus to appoint in every city?
What did a prophet of the Cretans say about his own people?
options: Always liars, evil beasts, idle gluttons
Lovers of wine and of money

questions.q: Which group of deceivers does Paul especially single out?
They profess that they know God, but ____.
questions.answer: by their deeds they deny him
wrong: in their hearts they doubt him
by their words they mock him

questions.q: The overseer must be blameless: not self pleasing, not easily angered, ____, not violent.
Not paying attention to ____ and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

items: Greeting to Titus, his true child
To the pure, all things are pure

questions.q: Paul tells Titus to reprove the deceivers sharply so they may be sound in the faith.
Paul says the saying about the Cretans is not true.
Whom are the older women to train?
What is Titus told to exhort the younger men to be?
What does the grace of God instruct us to deny?
Why should servants show all good fidelity?
options: To adorn the doctrine of God our Savior

questions.q: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. ____.
Looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of ____, Jesus Christ.
And purify for himself a people for his own possession, ____.
Paul says the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation only to the Jews.
Paul wants Titus's sound speech to leave opponents ashamed, with nothing evil to say.
How does Paul describe what we once were?
Where does Paul plan to spend the winter?
When should Titus avoid a factious man?
options: After a first and second warning

questions.q: Whom does Paul tell Titus to send on their journey speedily?
Not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but ____, he saved us.
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for ____.
That being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to ____.

items: Be subject to rulers and authorities
Insist so believers maintain good works
Greetings from all who are with Paul

questions.q: Paul tells Titus to engage in disputes about the law to correct false teachers.
Paul says the Holy Spirit was poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ.
